Maya — thanks, and great to hear Novacore wants to move forward. I put together a quick mutual action plan and an initial timeline for the MSA/DPA/order-form handoff. See the attached MAP_Novacore_v1.xlsx (high-level milestones). Summary below: 

Proposed high-level milestones (targets):
- May 6: Redwood sends DPA draft + order form template (sent)
- May 11: Procurement/legal kickoff (30–45 min) — review DPA scope, SOC2 evidence needs, and ordering quantities
- May 14: Novacore returns DPA redlines + list of SOC2 controls to confirm
- May 21: Redwood legal responds to redlines; commercial team finalizes order form pricing
- May 25: Final sign-and-return (DocuSign) -> provisioning starts within 48 hours

Notes / asks from Novacore: please prepare the SOC2 report or pointer to your compliance contact, an internal data-classification note, and the primary billing contact for the order form.

Laura — tagging you for legal review of the DPA approach (attached draft will show our preference to keep DPA as a standalone appendix to the MSA, but we can bind it into the MSA if Novacore prefers a single instrument).

Rishi / Grace — I’ll need support on price confirmation and on the onboarding runbook once contracts are in place.

Thanks,

Jonas / team —

Thanks for the draft DPA and the MAP. I reviewed novacore_dpa_draft_v1.pdf quickly and have the following high-level feedback before the kickoff: 

1) DPA structure: our preference is to keep the DPA as a standalone agreement (exhibit to the MSA) to avoid re-negotiating MSA commercial terms when privacy language needs small updates. Please flag if Novacore has a strict single-document policy.

2) Security evidence: we’ll need Novacore to provide the latest SOC2 Type II report (or an AICPA bridge letter) and the contact for their security operations lead. If SOC2 is delayed, we can accept an SSAE bridge + a scoped questionnaire, but that will affect timeline.

3) Data residency / retention: Novacore must confirm retention windows and any required EU-data handling clauses (if any workloads move to EU regions).

4) Order form: I recommend enabling a versioned order form template so pricing changes can be tracked separately from the MSA. Rishi, please prepare the rate card and a one-line summary of any volume discount thresholds by May 14.

I will prepare a redline of the DPA and a short list of non-negotiable clauses (liability cap, permitted subprocessors, breach notification timing) ahead of the May 11 call.
